steps.prompt: Is the person unconscious, not breathing, or showing severe shivering with confusion?
Call emergency services immediately. Handle the person very gently — do not massage limbs. If not breathing and you are trained, begin CPR. Keep them horizontal.
steps.cta: Call emergency services — keep horizontal and still

steps.prompt: Move them to a warm shelter out of the wind and wet. Remove any wet clothing. Insulate with dry blankets, clothing, or sleeping bag — cover the head.
If fully conscious and able to swallow, give warm (not hot) sweet drinks. Do not give alcohol. Do not rub or massage limbs — this can send cold blood to the heart.
For frostbite: do NOT thaw the affected area if there is any risk of it refreezing — this causes more damage. Cover loosely with a clean dry dressing.
Even if the person seems to be improving, seek medical care for all significant cold exposure and any frostbite. Rewarming should be done under medical supervision.
steps.cta: Warm gently and seek medical care
